messages:
Alice W: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — thanks everyone for the writeup. Main takeaways: failover didn't complete within 30s twice, load spike + delayed healthcheck on two replicas. We need concrete runbook updates and owners. Ticket: PMTKT-4421.
Ben K: I'll own the 'verify failover' remediation and add an automated smoke check that runs after any leader election. ETA: EOD Fri 2025-06-27.
Carlos R: I'll update the playbook steps for on-call to include the exact commands to check health and force failover if needed. Will add both short and deep-dive sections.
Dana S: @Ben K and @Carlos R please add unit links to the dedicated dashboards (latency, leader_age) in the runbook. Also we should add a quick checklist for when 2+ failovers happen in a 24h window.
Erin M: Noted recurring pattern: we saw similar symptoms in Apr (see INC-2025-0412). Suggest adding a 'recurring incident' tag and retention of 30d for relevant logs.
incident-bot: severity set to P2 by oncall at 1745432100. Note: follow-ups required.
Ben K: Draft of commands I'll add to the playbook (short troubleshooting):
`# check pod health across shards
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o wide
# check leader age metric (promql)
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[5m])`
Carlos R: For forced failover, I'll document the safe sequence we tested: 1) cordon node, 2) drain pods with grace 60s, 3) trigger manual leader promotion script. Include rollback notes and when to page SRE.
Alice W: Action items summary (please confirm ownership & ETA):
- Update runbook triage steps + commands: Carlos R, ETA Tue 2025-06-24
- Add automated smoke check after election: Ben K, ETA Fri 2025-06-27
- Dashboard links + alert tweak: Dana S, ETA Mon 2025-06-23
- Add recurring-incident tag + log retention change: Erin M, ETA Wed 2025-06-25
- Run a dry-run of manual failover doc with oncall: Carlos R & Ben K, target date Wed 2025-06-26
Dana S: I'll file a follow-up ticket to adjust the alert thresholds and add the dashboard links (TICK-887).
Erin M: Suggest adding a one-line 'when to escalatet to infra' at top of playbook. Saves time in noisy incidents.
Carlos R: Also adding a quick grep snippet to find the leader election errors: `rg "leader-election.*failed" /var/log/*.log -n`
Ben K: I'll wire up the smoke check to run in our post-deploy pipeline and surface failures to a new channel #smoke-fails.
Alice W: Good. Once owners confirm, I'll create the consolidated follow-up doc and assign these OTRs in the PM ticket. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
Ben K: :white_check_mark:
Carlos R: :white_check_mark: I'll drop a PR link once the draft runbook is in docs.
Dana S: :white_check_mark: Filing TICK-887 now.
Erin M: :white_check_mark: I'll update the retention in infra-ops config and note it in the ticket.
Alice W: Final note — let's aim to close action items within two weeks and schedule a 30-min review to validate the runbook changes. Thanks all.
incident-bot: Reminder set: review follow-ups in 7 days.
